text: In a GST phase-change synapse, the RESET operation (crystalline to amorphous) is achieved by:
choices: A long, moderate-power pulse that holds the film near 150-200 C to let atoms order
A continuous low DC bias that slowly crystallizes the film
A short, intense pulse that briefly melts the film (above ~600 C) followed by a rapid quench that freezes it disordered
Cooling the film below room temperature to freeze the lattice
explanation: RESET amorphizes by a short, intense melt-quench pulse (above ~600 C then rapid quench), which lowers absorption and raises the weight. Choice 0 describes SET (crystallization at ~150-200 C); choices 1 and 3 are not the described mechanisms, since crystallization needs heating above the crystallization temperature, not a low DC bias or cooling.
